data.title: SpaceX's Mobile Plans Trigger Towering Gains For These Stocks

data.title: Ryder Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
data.description: In Miami, the Board of Directors of Ryder System, Inc. announced a regular quarterly cash dividend of $1.01 per share of common stock. This marks the company's 201st consecutive quarterly cash dividend, demonstrating 50 years of consistent dividend payments. Ryder System, Inc. (NYSE: R) is a major player in the outsourced logistics and transportation services sector, with a market value of nearly $13 billion.

data.title: Over 70 people rally in support of Thunder Bay library workers: ‘If you have to strike, we’ll be with you on the picket line’
data.description: In Thunder Bay, Ontario, more than 70 individuals gathered for a solidarity rally on Thursday evening, October 8, to show support for Thunder Bay Public Library (TBPL) workers. The rally occurred outside the Waverley Branch as the library faces a potential strike with a deadline approaching in a week. Coinciding with the library's Board of Directors' monthly meeting, the rally aimed to protest against the board's insistence on concessions during negotiations. Margaret Demillo, the President of CU, emphasized the workers' desire for a fair agreement that allows them to continue their passion for their work.
